notes: MOTHER DOUBTED (research 2026-07-04, resolving the parent-too-young flag on Martha Taber Hedger, I182195863486): William's 1728 birth predates every attested marriage/wife found for father Peter Cheesman (his documented second wife, Ann Hanna Ellis, married him in either 1732 or c.1746; his eventual wife Martha Taber Hedger's own marriage to Peter is undated but, per an independent 1781 land-deed reference, came after Ann Ellis's 1759 death). William cannot plausibly be Martha's son (she would have been 8) and probably isn't Ann Ellis's son either -- he likely belongs to an unidentified, even earlier first wife of Peter's. Alternatively, per Richard Cheesman's (Peter's father) own documented children, Peter had a BROTHER named William Cheesman (b. abt 1713 Hempstead, d. 1766 Gloucester Co. NJ, named in Peter's 1786 will as 'my brother William(3) Cheesman') -- a different birth year than this record's 1728, so not a confirmed match, but raising the possibility that this 'William Cheesman b.1728' is a misfiled/duplicated relative rather than a true son of Peter's at all. Machine-owned parents array left unedited per repo convention. Full writeup: docs/research/ancestors/gen09-martha-taber-hedger-eliza-bolton-taber.md.
